title: Generated API adapter reports malformed success JSON as network failure
role_org_permissions: Response classification is independent of identity; the focused test calls a generated JSON operation through the adapter with only transport/session dependencies controlled. Guest/member/admin credential and organization behavior are tracked separately.
preconditions: A generated JSON operation receives HTTP 200 with malformed JSON.
reproduction: Call a generated operation through runOp with a successful response whose JSON parser throws SyntaxError.
The generated operation propagates that exception; runOp's generic catch returns status 0.
expected: A malformed successful response returns STATUS_INVALID_BODY (-1); a true network failure returns 0.
actual: Source-confirmed malformed-success SyntaxError maps to generic status 0, mislabeling a server body failure as a connection failure.
cause: Generated request parsing lets response.json() SyntaxError escape; the adapter handles every non-MatrxApiError as a network error.
sibling_census: runOp is the shared adapter for generated operations. The old rawRequest client and withSchema already distinguish invalid body status -1 from network status 0. A single adapter branch fixes every generated JSON operation.
severity: S2: misleading error classification for invalid successful responses
evidence: @ai-matrx/api 0.1.10 published dist/index.js JSON request path awaits response.json() without converting SyntaxError (line 274).
src/lib/api/client.ts existing successful-response parser returns STATUS_INVALID_BODY for body parse errors.
src/lib/api/matrx-api-session.test.ts adds real generated-operation malformed-JSON and TypeError network cases; host pressure level 2 prevented guarded test admission, so test is unrun.
